title: First independently anchored repository-query evaluation cases
status: planning artifact only; no new ACs, implementation or runnable tests
scope_notes: Source expectations were derived independently from immutable Git content, not from Neo4j output or the query compiler.
4503 canonical ID-bearing AC YAML records exist at the pinned source. Uncommitted AC-audit additions are excluded from this baseline.
Each negative/control case specifies an evidence-pack transformation for a future harness; no source, index, catalog or runtime was changed.
Expected answer_state labels are evaluation vocabulary, not currently implemented API enum claims.
This first batch samples 6 of 8 families and is not a representative benchmark of all 25 role questions. RQ3 and RQ5 remain future cases.
The current entity-ID evaluator cannot directly execute these required-field, completeness, routing and tracing assertions; harness/AC design comes later.
No live Jev, Neo4j, Langfuse, embedding or other network request was made. Prior local observations are labeled separately.
shared_answer_rules: Pin and cite repository source revision; distinguish that revision from a historical report tested_revision.
State scope and counting policy, deduplicate canonical IDs, and do not convert partial results into exact totals.
Missing required fields mean an unresolved answer; never silently substitute a similarly named field.
Declared tests, recorded work status, historical execution evidence and actual question satisfaction are different facts.
Unsupported sources, missing query capabilities, completed empty results, outages, denied access and budget exhaustion remain distinct.
No evidence of a trace is not permission to invent a trace; runtime diagnosis requires corresponding runtime evidence.
